scientific_integrity: Analytic transition-and-renewal proof supplemented by finite exact-rational checks. No independent audit, experimental-data inference, or universal extension is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for the fair doubling map with the identity observable and length-three ordinal windows. Earlier equivalent Markov-renewal calculations may exist; exhaustive priority is not established. Conditional entrance intervals differ from ordinary cell-return intervals. Exact Markov property does not extend automatically to other maps or measured processes.
title: Exact entrance-return laws for all length-three ordinal cells of the doubling map
